interface.signature: def klengthpref(arr: list[str], n: int, k: int, str: str) -> int:

preconditions.expression: all(isinstance(x, str) and x.islower() and x.isalpha() for x in arr) and isinstance(str, str) and str.islower() and str.isalpha()
preconditions.description: All strings in arr and the input string str must consist only of lowercase English alphabets.

preconditions.expression: 1 <= n <= 1000 and 1 <= k <= 1000 and 1 <= len(str) <= 1000 and all(1 <= len(x) <= 1000 for x in arr)
preconditions.description: n is the size of arr (1 ≤ n ≤ 1000), k is a positive integer (1 ≤ k ≤ 1000), and all strings in arr and str have lengths between 1 and 1000.
k must not exceed the length of str, ensuring the k-length prefix of str exists.

postconditions.expression: return_value == sum(1 for s in arr if len(s) >= k and s[:k] == str[:k])
postconditions.description: The function returns the count of strings in arr whose first k characters match the first k characters of str. Only strings in arr with length ≥ k are considered.
